snippet.title: Rosas are Red - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231150/Rosas_are_Red/

Rosas are Red is a texting-based game where you talk to a kind-hearted girl named Rosa! As you get to know her, she’ll happily fool around with you and send you fun little pictures.
